column1: # Table A (D9): obligation definitions, stored ONCE. Wave-0 seed: the five
# contracts wave 0 itself enforces; Waves 1-2 populate the quantity/state/
# option matrices from the censuses. All names placeholder pending naming.

column2: title
column3: meaning

column2: every reachable public name classifies 4-way
column3: counted set: dir(torchlens) non-underscore (module layer) + dir(cls) non-underscore for module-level classes (class layer); classes = declared|submodule|deprecated|undeclared; undeclared requires a dated KNOWN-GAP row

column2: every option/entry parameter is cache-keyed or witnessed-dont-care
column3: counted set: public fields of the six Options groups + tl.trace parameters; covered = cache_config key (alias-mapped) | dont-care with witness slot | dated KNOWN-GAP row; burden-inverted per D14

column2: a call warns deprecation iff the registry says so
column3: behavior root: observed CALLS through invocation templates, never metadata (D6); warning must name the registered replacement and the replacement must resolve (D21)

column2: the public-surface denominator is multi-root anchored
column3: counted set: len(__all__); roots: static AST parse, runtime length, PUBLIC_SURFACE_SIZE constant, TARGET_ALL ledger length, classification-baseline declared count; the reachable denominator publishes beside it with its counted set (D8)

column2: published numerals are censused with a dated legacy baseline
column3: counted set: NUMERAL_COUNTED_SET in tests/oracles/_censuses.py; stale baseline rows block; FactRef enforcement for NEW numerals lands Wave 2 (H5)

column2: a module's address depth equals its dotted-address component count
column3: dotted components of the module address below the root; the root address 'self' is 0; unit: levels

column2: the branching factor equals the hand-counted mean fan-out
column3: mean number of children (consumers) per compute Op; unit: children per op (float)

column2: an op's read traffic equals its read-once closed form
column3: theoretical ideal read-once bytes: every input tensor and every parameter of the op read once; unit: bytes

column2: an op's write traffic equals its write-once closed form
column3: theoretical ideal write-once bytes of the op's outputs; unit: bytes

column2: a module's call depth equals its hand-counted nesting depth
column3: nesting depth of the module's call in the call tree, a top-level child at 1; unit: levels

column2: the unaccounted-dispatch count equals the planted gap count
column3: aten dispatch events the completeness witness observed that no captured op accounts for; unit: events

column2: the maximum in-degree equals the hand-counted parent maximum
column3: maximum number of parents over compute Ops; unit: edges

column2: the maximum out-degree equals the hand-counted child maximum
column3: maximum number of children over compute Ops; unit: edges

column2: the backward-pass count equals the number of backward calls issued
column3: backward calls recorded on the trace; unit: passes

column2: the compute-edge count equals the hand count
column3: distinct Op-graph edges whose endpoints are both compute Ops; unit: edges

column2: the module count equals the source model's submodule count
column3: registered source-model submodules; unit: modules

column2: a buffer's overwrite count equals the hand-counted writes
column3: write events recorded for one buffer address; unit: writes

column2: the saved-op count equals the ops the save selection names
column3: Ops whose activation was retained by the capture; unit: ops

column2: retained activation bytes equal the physically retained storage
column3: physical bytes of retained activation payloads (raw and transformed), each storage counted once; unit: bytes

column2: the parameter count equals its closed form on every door
column3: parameter elements in scope: a Trace or summary all declared parameters, a Module its own, a Layer or Op the parameters it consumes, a Param its own elements; unit: elements

column2: the parameter-tensor count equals its closed form on every door
column3: parameter tensors in scope (Trace, Layer, Op, Module, ModuleCall); unit: tensors

column2: the frozen-parameter count equals its closed form on every door
column3: elements of in-scope parameters with requires_grad False; unit: elements

column2: the trainable-parameter count equals its closed form on every door
column3: elements of in-scope parameters with requires_grad True; unit: elements

column2: the executed-parameter count equals its closed form on every door
column3: elements of declared parameters consumed by a captured op; unit: elements

column2: the unexecuted-parameter count equals its closed form on every door
column3: elements of declared parameters no captured op consumed; unit: elements

column2: forward MACs equal their closed form on every door
column3: true forward multiply-accumulates, never flops // 2; non-MAC ops count 0; unit: MACs

column2: forward FLOPs equal their closed form on every door
column3: forward floating-point operations, fma counted as 2 and bias adds counted; unit: FLOPs

column2: the op count equals its closed form on every door
column3: ops in scope; a Layer counts its passes, a module call counts its input and output boundary ops; unit: ops

column2: the pass count equals the number of times the op ran
column3: times a layer's op executed in the forward; unit: passes

column2: the edge count equals the hand-counted graph edges on every door
column3: distinct op-graph edges in scope, boundary edges included; unit: edges

column2: a tensor's activation bytes equal elements times element size on every door
column3: bytes of one observed tensor value (an op output, or a buffer's final observed value); a total sums the retained ones; unit: bytes

column2: parameter bytes equal elements times element size over the unique parameters
column3: storage bytes of the parameters in scope, each parameter tensor counted once however many names hold it; unit: bytes

column2: the trace's tensor count equals the hand-counted op passes
column3: op passes in the trace, boundary ops (inputs, outputs, buffer reads and writes) included; unit: ops

column2: the compute-op count equals the hand-counted non-boundary op passes
column3: op passes that are not an input, output or buffer boundary; unit: ops

column2: the compute-layer count equals the hand-counted non-boundary layers
column3: layers (repeated passes of one operation grouped) that are not boundaries; unit: layers

column2: the layer-edge count equals the hand-counted rolled-graph edges
column3: distinct (parent layer, child layer) pairs, a pass feeding the next pass of its own layer included; unit: edges

column2: the input-op count equals the number of model input tensors
column3: input boundary op passes, one per model input tensor; unit: ops

column2: the input-layer count equals the number of model input tensors
column3: input boundary layers, one per model input tensor; unit: layers

column2: the output-op count equals the number of model output tensors
column3: output boundary op passes, one per model output tensor; unit: ops

column2: the output-layer count equals the number of model output tensors
column3: output boundary layers, one per model output tensor; unit: layers

column2: the buffer-layer count equals the hand-counted buffer reads and writes
column3: buffer boundary layers: one per registered-buffer read and one per recorded write; unit: layers

column2: the buffer-read count equals the hand-counted registered-buffer reads
column3: buffer ops that bring a registered buffer's value into the graph; unit: ops

column2: the buffer-source count equals the hand-counted registered-buffer reads
column3: buffer ops that act as graph sources (the reads); unit: ops

column2: the buffer-write count equals the hand-counted recorded buffer writes
column3: buffer ops recording a write (in place, fused or reassigned) to a registered buffer; unit: ops

column2: the buffer-sink count equals the hand-counted recorded buffer writes
column3: buffer ops that end a buffer's dataflow (the writes); unit: ops

column2: the buffer-edge count equals the hand-counted edges touching a buffer op
column3: distinct op-graph edges with at least one buffer endpoint; unit: edges

column2: the internal-source count equals the hand-counted parentless non-input ops
column3: op passes with no parent that are not model inputs (factories and buffer reads); unit: ops

column2: the internal-source layer count equals the hand-counted parentless non-input layers
column3: layers of the internal-source ops; unit: layers

column2: the internal-sink count equals the hand-counted childless non-output ops
column3: op passes with no child that are not model outputs (discarded results and unread buffer writes); unit: ops

column2: the internal-sink layer count equals the hand-counted childless non-output layers
column3: layers of the internal-sink ops; unit: layers

column2: the parent count equals the hand-counted distinct producers
column3: distinct parent ops of an op, or distinct parent layers of a layer; unit: nodes

column2: the child count equals the hand-counted distinct consumers
column3: distinct child ops of an op, or distinct child layers of a layer; unit: nodes

column2: an op's input count equals its hand-counted graph parents
column3: distinct graph-parent ops feeding an op; unit: ops

column2: a module scope's internal edges equal the hand-counted edges inside it
column3: distinct op-graph edges whose both endpoints are ops of the module or call; unit: edges

column2: a module scope's input edges equal the hand-counted edges entering it
column3: distinct op-graph edges from an op outside the module or call to one inside; unit: edges

column2: a module scope's output edges equal the hand-counted edges leaving it
column3: distinct op-graph edges from an op inside the module or call to one outside; unit: edges

column2: the module-call count equals the hand-counted calls, the root call included
column3: module invocations in the trace, the root call counted once; unit: calls

column2: the uncalled-module count equals the hand-counted registered modules never called
column3: registered modules of the source model with no call in the trace; unit: modules

column2: the parameter-using op count equals the hand-counted op passes that read a parameter
column3: op passes that use at least one parameter tensor; unit: ops

column2: the parameter-using layer count equals the hand-counted layers that read a parameter
column3: layers with at least one op pass that uses a parameter tensor; unit: layers

column2: the saved-layer count equals the hand-counted layers with a retained activation
column3: layers with at least one op whose activation is retained; unit: layers

column2: the saved-call count equals the hand-counted calls with a retained output
column3: module calls, the root call included, with at least one output op whose activation is retained; unit: calls

column2: the saved-module count equals the hand-counted modules with a saved call
column3: modules with at least one saved module call; unit: modules

column2: the saved-gradient op count equals the hand-counted ops that received a gradient
column3: op passes whose output received and kept a gradient in backward; unit: ops

column2: the saved-gradient layer count equals the hand-counted layers that received a gradient
column3: layers with at least one op that kept a gradient; unit: layers

column2: the saved-gradient call count equals the hand-counted calls whose output received a gradient
column3: module calls, the root call included, with at least one output op that kept a gradient; unit: calls

column2: the saved-gradient module count equals the hand-counted modules with such a call
column3: modules with at least one saved-gradient module call; unit: modules

column2: the saved-gradient backward-node count equals the captured differentiable ops
column3: backward nodes (grad_fns) of captured forward ops that kept their gradients; unit: grad_fns

column2: the saved-gradient backward-call count equals saved nodes times backward passes
column3: calls of saved-gradient backward nodes, one per node per backward pass; unit: calls
